Lemma
[The Fibre Metric Against a Local Orthonormal Frame]

↗ def:fiber-metric-forms-pointwise ↗ def:inner-k-covectors ↗ prop:inner-k-covectors-frame-independent ↗ prop:existence-orthonormal-frames

If $(Y_1,\ldots ,Y_n)$ is a smooth local orthonormal frame and $x$ lies in its domain, then \[ \langle \omega ,\eta \rangle _g=\frac1{k!}\sum _{s:\{ 1,\ldots ,k\} \to \{ 1,\ldots ,n\} }\omega (Y_{s(1)},\ldots ,Y_{s(k)})\eta (Y_{s(1)},\ldots ,Y_{s(k)}). \]
Proof

↗ prop:inner-k-covectors-frame-independent \sketch The frame values are an orthonormal basis, so the formula is Definition 3 transported fibrewise.

□
